column7: Being a disciple-maker requires a blend of spiritual dependence, commitment, and humility. It is a calling that demands patience and persistence while remaining Spirit-led and teachable. Disciple-makers are not expected to be perfect, but they must be faithful-abiding in Christ, investing in others, and trusting God to bring the growth and transformation in His timing. These qualities reflect Christ’s love and help others become mature disciples who, in turn, can disciple others.
column8: Being a discipler requires a combination of spiritual dependence, commitment, and humility. It is a calling that demands patience and perseverance, while remaining both Spirit-led and teachable. Disciplers are not expected to be perfect, but to be faithful: remaining in Christ, investing in others, and trusting that God will bring growth and transformation in his time. These qualities reflect the love of Christ and help others become mature disciples who, in turn, can disciple others.
